money.heading: From research to a vetted shortlist
money.intro: You have the fee stack and market context. When you are ready to compare live inventory, use a commercial landing matched to your market, not a generic form.

yield.heading: Match yield math to live listings
yield.intro: Gross yield on a brochure is not net yield in your bank account. Bridge from the numbers above to areas and units our partners actually quote.

visa.heading: Property that qualifies for UAE Golden Visa
visa.intro: The AED 2M threshold is about registered value, escrow status, and title, not marketing price. Start with qualifying inventory before you pay a reservation fee.

offplan.heading: Escrow-checked launches, not brochure hype
offplan.intro: Off-plan works when escrow, developer track record, and payment plan penalties are verified before deposit. Bridge to inventory with handover timelines attached.

abu-dhabi.heading: Freehold areas with ADM-backed titles
abu-dhabi.intro: Abu Dhabi fee stacks and tenant profiles differ from Dubai. Use Abu Dhabi-specific shortlists when your thesis is yield plus stability, not volume flipping.

abu-dhabi-offplan.heading: New stock on Yas, Saadiyat, and Al Reem
abu-dhabi-offplan.intro: Abu Dhabi off-plan requires ADM escrow verification and realistic handover timelines. Bridge from research to launches with payment plans attached.

rak.heading: Coastal yield with lower entry than Dubai
rak.intro: RAK headlines often beat Dubai on gross yield, but liquidity is thinner. Match Al Marjan and Mina Al Arab stock to your hold period before you commit.

compare.heading: Compare markets with a single brief
compare.intro: When you are weighing Dubai vs Abu Dhabi vs RAK (or wider Gulf), send one brief and get options per market instead of bouncing between generic forms.

area-qatar.heading: Freehold zones with pegged currency
area-qatar.intro: Qatar yields are stable but zone-specific. Confirm Ministry of Justice registration on the exact unit before you model returns from a Pearl brochure map.

area-saudi.heading: Foreign ownership where eligible
area-saudi.intro: Saudi rules are project-specific, not Dubai-style open freehold. Bridge to vetted projects only after legal eligibility is confirmed for your profile.

area-bahrain.heading: Lower entry, pegged currency
area-bahrain.intro: Bahrain can beat Dubai on headline yield, but tower OPEX varies sharply. Bridge to listings with service charge schedules attached, not brochure net yields.

area-oman.heading: Muscat freehold for hold-and-rent
area-oman.intro: Oman suits lifestyle and long-hold rental theses more than Dubai-style flipping. Bridge to ITC and Al Mouj stock with realistic vacancy assumptions.
